entries.c653d34c65d32b89: Under its corporate philosophy, "leaving for the future a society in symbiosis with nature," its management policy is to contribute to local communities and enhance corporate value sustainably, as a corporate group that positions the Comprehensive Construction Consultant Business in the field of social infrastructure, the Sports Facility Operation Business in health, and the Aquarium Operation Business in social education. In its first medium-term management plan, from the fiscal year ended July 2024 to the fiscal year ending July 2026, it positions this period as a period for rebuilding its business base and sets a human resources strategy, a technology strategy, and a market strategy; in the market strategy, it sets out making disaster prevention and mitigation-related work a priority business development field, expanding orders in the Kanto and Kyushu regions, expanding franchised stores of sports facilities, and opening new small urban aquariums.
